thread:
Maya (support): Hey team, incoming from ACME Ops — their embedding requests are returning vectors of length 768 but their app expects 1024. Customer says this started after they rotated keys and added a new org header. They are also seeing increased latency and some requests billed to the wrong project. Can eng + billing help repro and triage?

ACME Ops (customer): sending a minimal repro below. We call /v1/embeddings and get a model named `embed-small-768` back even though our project config pins `embed-standard-1024`. This used to work earlier today. Example: 

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_ABC123" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-987" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello world","model":"auto"}'
```

Response:
```json
{
  "model": "embed-small-768",
  "embedding": [0.12, -0.03, ...],
  "dimension": 768
}
```

Carlos (eng-se): thx Maya. quick hypothesis: precedence bug between API key project binding and explicit org header. If an API key is scoped to project A but you set X-Redwood-Org for org B, the routing layer might incorrectly prefer the API-key-to-project mapping and pick project A's model policy, or worse, pick a per-api-key default model that is 768-dim. Need to see headers + which API key used.

Maya (support): customer pasted headers and key id privately — sk_proj_ABC123 belongs to project `acme-legacy` which has default embedding `embed-small-768`. Their intended project `acme-new` (org-987) has default `embed-standard-1024`. They rotated to a new org-scoped key but still supply the old project-scoped key in their client by mistake.

Priya (eng-ml): I can repro locally. When model selection flow is: 1) if `model` param explicit -> use it; 2) else consult project config resolved from request.project (derived from API key) -> else consult org config (from X-Redwood-Org). There's a bug when both exist: we fall back to API-key project first even if `X-Redwood-Org` is present and the org's policy has a higher priority in our intended design.

Carlos (eng-se): reproduce steps I used: 
```bash
# simulated request with old project-scoped key but org header for new project
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_ABC123" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-987" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"test","model":"auto"}' -i
```
Server log excerpt: 
```
[13:45:02] auth: resolved subject=project:acme-legacy from api_key sk_proj_ABC123
[13:45:02] routing: org_header=org-987 project_header=null
[13:45:02] model-resolver: selected model=embed-small-768 (from project acme-legacy)
[13:45:02] runtime: started serving embed-small-768 (dim=768)
```
Priya (eng-ml): Also saw increased latency for requests that got routed through a cross-project fallback path because we attempted to map keys to legacy pools and there was an extra lookup + cache miss. That explains the latency spike reported by the customer.

Nate (billing): on billing side we saw tokens charged to `acme-legacy` for those request ids. If the customer expects usage billed to `acme-new` that's why invoices don't match. We should suggest a short remediation and a retro billing adjustment if they confirm the intended project.

Maya (support): Proposed next steps: 1) Confirm intended project for customer (they confirm `acme-new`). 2) Provide quick repro + fix guidance to customer (use correct API key or explicitly set `X-Redwood-Project: acme-new` header). 3) Eng to patch precedence bug to prefer explicit org/project headers over legacy api-key binding when keys are org-scoped. 4) Billing to queue adjustment ticket.

ACME Ops (customer): okay we can switch keys but the client is deployed and keyed with the old secret in dozens of pods. Would prefer a server-side mitigation while we roll keys.

Carlos (eng-se): short-term mitigation deployed to staging: if X-Redwood-Project or X-Redwood-Org header is present *and* the Authorization API key's project differs, log a high-severity event and prefer the explicit header's project for model selection for the next 30 minutes for that API key (grace period) to allow rotation. We'll roll to prod after smoke tests.

deploy-bot: started deployment r-2026.3.1 to prod (canary 10%)

Priya (eng-ml): tested canary: requests with old key + org header now select `embed-standard-1024` and return dim=1024. Example: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_ABC123" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-987" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' -i
```
Response header: `X-Redwood-Routing: project=acme-new (from header), key_project=acme-legacy`
Response body includes "dimension": 1024.

Maya (support): sent customer recommended short-term commands: 
1) Option A (immediate): set env var REDWOOD_API_KEY to the new key sk_org_NEW999 in all pods and restart. 
2) Option B (less immediate): keep old key, add header `X-Redwood-Project: acme-new` in the client for now (we provided a sidecar patch example).

ACME Ops (customer): confirmed adding `X-Redwood-Project` to client fixed immediate issue. We still want billing corrected for the last 6000 requests.

Nate (billing): created ticket BILL-4438 to credit `acme-legacy` charges and move them to `acme-new` for request ids provided by customer. Need sign-off from customer.

Carlos (eng-se): long-term fix: we'll change model resolver precedence so explicit request headers (X-Redwood-Project / X-Redwood-Org) override API-key-derived project when the customer indicates header intent. We'll include a safety audit log entry for every override and a config flag to restore previous behavior if needed. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/6421

Priya (eng-ml): also adding an extra validation on client SDKs: if user attempts to call `model=auto` and the API key resolves to a different project than an explicit project/org header, warn at client-level (SDK warning) so devs see mismatches during rollout.

Maya (support): customer happy with mitigation + billing ticket. Closing loop: asked ACME Ops to confirm after 24h and will re-open if any regressions.

ACME Ops (customer): thanks everyone — will confirm after our rollout completes. :tada:

Carlos (eng-se): follow-up tasks: 1) prod rollout of mitigation fully (done 2026-03-12 16:20 UTC), 2) merge PR 6421 + deploy (ETA 48h), 3) postmortem (assigning to Priya).

Priya (eng-ml): noted. I'll write a short postmortem focusing on precedence, cache invalidation that caused latency, and billing fallout. Will include repro steps and customer timeline.

Maya (support): thanks all — marking as resolved for support. If ACME Ops re-confirms billing and no other reports, we'll archive thread. :white_check_mark:
